# The skills the Sandcastle workflow installs on the runner for the run, which
# lib/skills.mts mounts into the sandbox from ~/.claude/skills (they are the
# SANDBOX_SKILLS in .sandcastle/lib/repo-config.mts). A hosted runner has none.
#
# The workflow (Owned by the repo-ci-baseline Template) reads this file as data
# and runs no script of the repo's. Blank (or whitespace-only) lines and comments (a # in column 0)
# are ignored, LF line endings only, and any other line is one of two kinds:
#
#   dotfiles-sha <40 lowercase hex digits>   the commit of the Application Factory's main (mpaulosky/Application_Factory) to take them from, given once
#   skill <name>                             a skill under ".claude/skills/" there, once each
#
# Pin the commit like an action, so a push to the Factory can't change what the
# agents are told until the pin moves. The skills become the agents'
# instructions, so have a person review every change to this file.
#
# With neither kind of line, the workflow installs nothing.

dotfiles-sha 75b5ba96a9f222dabc13be43f94f7f16030e8cbf
skill dotnet-tdd
skill dotnet-add-testing
skill dotnet-xunit
skill dotnet-testing-strategy
skill dotnet-project-analysis
skill dotnet-inspect
